name: Cursor OG social card by cursor.com
description: A link-preview card reduced to its absolute minimum: a near-black canvas (roughly 1200×630) with a single white lockup dead-center, both horizontally and at optical vertical center. The mark is a hexagonal cube whose interior is cut away so a cursor arrow appears in negative space; the wordmark CURSOR sits to its right in an extended, all-caps geometric sans with wide tracking, sized so the letter height matches the mark. Focal hierarchy comes purely from scale and contrast — no tagline, URL, gradient, or decoration anywhere, which keeps it legible even when the card renders at thumbnail size. The vast empty field is the actual design decision: it makes the small white lockup feel deliberate and confident rather than sparse.
